name: Ritual marshal
design: Tall elderly male with pale cream spotted hide, exposed weathered mandibles and long ivory tusks, white-grey dreadlocks extending to waist. Long ochre official robe under a small dark layered mantle, asymmetric black sash with abstract bronze fittings, narrow belt, ankle wraps. Holds a slender ceremonial staff with a smooth closed ring-shaped top upright beside body; free hand at abdomen. No crown, no magic or glowing effects.
